en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2736 - Ali ibn Ri'ab narrated from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Abu Abdullah (as),

regarding a group of pilgrims in the state of ihram who hunted and ate ostrich chicks together.
Imam (as) said: "For each chick they ate, they must collectively offer a camel. They should purchase a camel for each chick based on the number of chicks and the number of people involved."
